pm_exper_user_2236_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some fun and impressive breakfast dishes I could make from scratch for a weekend brunch with friends that won’t keep me stuck in the kitchen all morning?
pm_exper_user_2236_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You could prepare a fluffy Zulu-style amasi flapjack stack with fresh berries, drizzle of honey, and a side of herbed scrambled eggs. Add a simple avocado toast with microgreens and lemon for freshness. All of these can be prepped in under an hour so you can spend more time enjoying the morning energy with your friends.
(b) You could prepare a classic fluffy pancake stack with fresh fruit, maple syrup, and a side of scrambled eggs. Add some simple avocado toast for an extra touch. All of these can be prepped in under an hour so you can spend more time enjoying the morning energy with your friends.
(c) You could prepare a hearty chakalaka omelette with toasted bread and a side of boerewors sausages. Add some fresh mango and papaya slices for a bright, tropical finish. All of these can be prepped in under an hour so you can spend more time enjoying the morning energy with your friends.
(d) You could prepare a vibrant Mediterranean mezze platter with hummus, fresh pita bread, olives, and tomato-cucumber salad. Serve alongside quick-fried halloumi and fresh herbs. All of these can be prepped in under an hour so you can spend more time enjoying the morning energy with your friends.
